The finite search is exhaustive because every clique has exactly one increasing-index listing.

value.rationale: This is the first directly relevant five-mer intersection of four independent practical code constraints in the compared literature: the extra single-substitution-detection requirement reduces the established 24-word ceiling to an exact 14 words. The entire finite codebook polynomial and seven equality symmetry classes give the natural complete finite design space, not a contrived arbitrary slice or a known-table recomputation. The exact small-block capacity and symmetry classification can guide short synchronization-primer design; no physical performance claim is made.
